description: Validation rules specific to Virginia Department of Health CSV files

rules.name: csv_structure_valid
rules.description: File must be valid CSV with consistent column count
rules.condition: CSV parsing fails or column count varies across rows

rules.name: locality_identifier_present
rules.description: Each row must have locality identifier (FIPS code or locality name)
rules.condition: Locality column is NULL or empty
rules.rationale: Locality is primary key for VDH aggregated data
rules.action_on_failure: Fail file if >5% rows missing locality

rules.name: small_count_suppression_tolerance
rules.description: Counts <10 may be suppressed for privacy
rules.rationale: VDH suppresses small counts to prevent re-identification

rules.name: health_opportunity_index_range
rules.description: HOI scores must be in valid range (0-100)
rules.action_on_failure: Drop row if <5% affected; fail file if >=5%

rules.name: wic_participation_counts_non_negative
rules.rationale: Negative counts indicate data entry error
rules.action_on_failure: Drop row if <5% affected; fail file if >=5%

rules.name: temporal_field_aggregated
rules.description: VDH data typically annual; derive period_id from file metadata
rules.rationale: Annual aggregate data lacks individual-level temporal precision
rules.action_on_failure: Set low_precision_time=1; use file metadata or assume current year

rules.name: fips_code_format_validation
rules.description: FIPS codes must be 5-digit strings (2-digit state + 3-digit county)
rules.condition: FIPS code does not match pattern ^51\d{3}$ (Virginia counties)
rules.rationale: Malformed FIPS codes prevent geographic joins

rules.name: locality_name_standardization
rules.description: Locality names should match Virginia county/city naming conventions
rules.condition: Locality name not in standard Virginia locality list

rules.name: composite_index_components_optional
rules.description: HOI composite score may be present without all component scores
rules.condition: HOI composite present but education/economic/environmental/social components NULL
rules.rationale: VDH may provide composite without publishing all components

rules.name: csv_encoding_utf8
rules.rationale: Ensures proper handling of special characters (e.g., accented names)
rules.action_on_failure: Attempt to decode with fallback encodings; warn

low_precision_time.description: Annual aggregate data; no monthly granularity
low_precision_time.impact: Excluded from month-stratified analyses; contribute to overall counts

vdh_specific_assumptions.temporal_coverage: Typically annual snapshots; WIC may be quarterly
vdh_specific_assumptions.data_updates: Irregular; datasets refreshed annually or as available

validation_pass_criteria.v1_strict: All required columns present; no suppressed counts allowed
validation_pass_criteria.v2_relaxed: Core schema intact + locality identifier + <5% suppressed cells

cross_references.hoi_methodology: VCU Center on Society and Health
